decks.notes: This deck aims to disrupt opponents with counterspells and removal while quickly ramping into powerful threats like Narset, Parter of Veils and Bolas's Citadel. The deck also utilizes powerful card draw spells like Treasure Cruise and Dig Through Time to maintain card advantage and tempo. The inclusion of Time Vault and Voltaic Key combo provides additional win conditions. The deck is focused on controlling the board and tempo of the game, making efficient use of mana acceleration and efficient card draw to overpower the opponent.

The focus of this deck is to aggressively utilize cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures like Vengevine and Squee, Goblin Nabob, enabling powerful plays early in the game. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will helps to control the board while maintaining pressure. The deck also features cards like Force of Vigor and Noxious Revival for graveyard recursion and removal, allowing the player to maintain a constant tempo and overwhelming presence on the battlefield.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive MUD strategies with powerful artifacts and disruptive cards to overwhelm the opponent. It aims to lock down the opponent's resources with cards like Chalice of the Void and Sphere of Resistance, while utilizing mana acceleration from cards like Sol Ring and Mishra's Workshop to deploy threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Golos, Tireless Pilgrim. The deck also includes cards like Crucible of Worlds and Ghost Quarter to disrupt the opponent's manabase and control the tempo of the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful and efficient cards to control the board and tempo of the game while applying pressure with creatures. It includes disruptive counterspells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm, card draw spells like Dig Through Time and Treasure Cruise, along with efficient removal in Swords to Plowshares. The deck also includes powerful finishers such as Sphinx of the Steel Wind and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade. The mana acceleration provided by Moxen and artifact ramp like Sol Ring and Mana Crypt allows the deck to play its threats ahead of schedule and maintain its tempo advantage.

The deck focuses on assembling powerful artifact combos, particularly utilizing Coveted Jewel to generate advantage and fuel various strategies that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing key mana acceleration cards like Mishra's Workshop and powerful artifacts like Time Vault, the deck aims to establish a dominating board state. With access to disruptive spells like Force of Will and the ability to tutor for key pieces with cards like Tinker and Urza's Saga, the deck looks to execute its game plan efficiently and effectively to secure victory.

The deck focuses on combining aggressive creatures like Tarmogoyf and Oko, Thief of Crowns with disruptive spells like Force of Will and Assassin's Trophy to control the board while applying pressure. The deck also utilizes powerful cards like Leovold, Emissary of Trest and Narset, Parter of Veils to generate card advantage and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, it has a strong mana base with fetch lands and mana accelerants like Mox Jet to ensure smooth gameplay. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure while maintaining control over the game through disruption and card advantage.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly deploy disruptive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria to slow down the opponent's game plan, while also utilizing cards like Emeria's Call and Solitude to deal with threats efficiently. The deck aims to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategies, taking advantage of powerful mana acceleration from cards like Mana Crypt and Moxen to get ahead in the game. With a mix of hatebears and aggressive creatures, this deck aims to apply pressure while disrupting the opponent's plans.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful control elements to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also setting up its own win condition. It includes a mix of powerful vintage cards such as Ancestral Recall and Time Walk, as well as mana acceleration through Moxen and Sol Ring. The deck aims to control the game through counterspells like Force of Will and removal like Swords to Plowshares, while also utilizing powerful tutors like Demonic Tutor and Vampiric Tutor to find key combo pieces. The win condition is often through a powerful threat like Sphinx of the Steel Wind or by assembling a Time Vault combo with cards like Manifold Key.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful artifact cards such as Coveted Jewel, Paradoxical Outcome, and Tinker to generate card advantage, mana acceleration, and combo potential. It aims to quickly assemble key pieces like Time Vault and Bolas's Citadel to create game-ending combos. With a mix of mana acceleration, disruption, and card draw, the deck aims to outpace and overwhelm opponents in the Vintage 1 vs 1 format, showcasing the potential for explosive and intricate plays with artifact synergy.

This deck focuses on utilizing Paradoxical Outcome to generate mana and draw cards, allowing the player to assemble the Time Vault combo and win the game. The deck includes powerful artifacts like Black Lotus and Mana Crypt, along with card draw and counterspells to protect the combo. The inclusion of Tinker and Demonic Tutor provides additional ways to find key combo pieces quickly. By efficiently drawing cards and generating mana, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game before the opponent can respond.

The deck focuses on aggressively disrupting the opponent's game plan with hatebear creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria, while also utilizing cards like Chalice of the Void and Wasteland to slow down their progress. The inclusion of cards like Solitude and Anointed Peacekeeper provide additional control elements, allowing the player to maintain board presence and apply pressure. Urza's Saga and White Plume Adventurer enhance the deck's consistency and card advantage, providing the player with the tools needed to outpace and outmaneuver their opponent in a fast-paced format like Vintage 1 vs 1.

This deck aims to control the game early on with efficient removal and countermagic, while utilizing card draw and selection effects to maintain card advantage and consistency. By utilizing the powerful combination of Jeskai colors and cards like Dreadhorde Arcanist and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade, the deck can disrupt opponents' game plans while applying pressure with efficient creatures. This deck aims to control the game through manipulating opponents' decks with Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo, utilizing various tutor spells and artifact acceleration to set up the win condition quickly. It also features disruptive elements like Trinisphere, Pyroblast, and Flusterstorm to disrupt opponent's plays and protect its own strategy. The deck's key strength lies in its ability to quickly assemble its combo pieces while disrupting opponents, making it a versatile and powerful control deck in the Vintage 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on using powerful artifacts and spells to generate a large amount of mana and draw cards, ultimately leading to a game-winning combo utilizing Paradoxical Outcome. With a strong mix of fast mana, card draw, and disruption, the goal is to efficiently assemble the necessary pieces to go off and win the game quickly before the opponent can respond. The deck aims to control the game early on, setting up its combo pieces while disrupting the opponent's game plan, then quickly transitioning into a game-winning combo using Paradoxical Outcome to generate a massive advantage.

The main focus of this deck is to establish control over the game by using a variety of artifact cards to lock down opponent's resources and disrupt their strategy. Cards like Sphere of Resistance, Thorn of Amethyst, and Trinisphere make it difficult for the opponent to cast spells, while cards like Smokestack and Tangle Wire create a resource advantage for the player. The deck also utilizes lands like Mishra's Workshop and Urza's Saga to ramp up quickly and deploy threats like Lodestone Golem and Patchwork Automaton to pressure the opponent. Overall, this deck aims to slow down the opponent and establish a dominant position on the battlefield.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with Dredge cards like Stinkweed Imp and Golgari Grave-Troll, allowing for explosive combos with cards like Narcomoeba and Prized Amalgam. Using Bazaar of Baghdad to repeatedly dump cards into the graveyard, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect its combo pieces and stall the opponent's strategy. Overall, the key concept of the deck is to leverage graveyard synergies to create a fast and resilient combo engine.
